newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian govt security prices edge up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian govt security prices edge up in light trade.

text.p: Indian government security prices were marginally up in quiet afternoon trade on Thursday, dealers said.
They said prices moved up slightly in cautious trade as the market awaits the announcement of a bond issue by the governemnt.

In latest deals, the 13.70 pervent 1999 stock traded at 105.87 rupees against its last traded 105.80, the 12.14 percent 2000 stock rose to 102.25 from 102.19 and the 12 percent 1999 to 102.97 from 102.93, dealers said.
Among other stocks, the 13.62 percent 1998 rose to 104.77 from 104.73, the 13.50 percvent 1998 to 103.65 from 103.60 and the 13.80 percent 2002 to 106.70 from 106.58.
Dealers said April 1998 maturity treasury bills traded at a yield between 8.23 and 8.25 percent against 8.25 percent.
